in_text_mentions: At this point, the patient was referred to our center to obtain a second opinion, given the unsatisfactory hearing improvement after surgery. A cone beam computed tomography (CBCT) of the temporal bone was performed, revealing bilateral enlarged vestibular aqueducts (EVAs) associated with a malformation of the ossicular chain, which appeared bilaterally fixed to the upper lateral wall of the middle ear (Figure 2). The vestibular aqueduct diameter at the midpoint resulted to be 1.74 mm on the right and 2.45 mm on the left.
